scope: Exploratory TRAIN-only ranking diagnostic on existing frozen QVT cache; not a detector release or XCLIP quality claim
selection: 26 exact-unique TRAIN contents, 24 automatic groups; exact duplicates contribute one unit, no label-dependent exclusion
positive_centroid: normalize the mean of normalized nearest-fixed-grid point representations, equal video weight
negative_centroid: normalize the mean of per-negative-video mean normalized window representations, equal video weight
score: cosine to positive centroid minus cosine to negative centroid
validation: leave entire TRAIN auto group out; both centroids fit only on remaining groups
interpretation: No ranking signal would weaken a cached-feature/head-only rescue. It would not prove that a genuinely temporal pretrained encoder cannot work. AUC alone does not satisfy fixed-threshold recall/specificity or legal event output.
